GBP activity remains strong with 118 total actions and 12 calls across both profiles, and CRM data shows 63 won opportunities out of 769 created over 28 days.

performance.verdict: Lead spike is real but thin; 9 SOW milestones overdue block any scale.

findings.text: 9 SOW milestones are overdue (earliest Jul 31); heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, and intake owner confirmation remain unresolved as of 2026-10-18.
28-day CPL is $66.26 on only 24 leads; all 24 came from Meta — Google Ads logged 8 conversions separately but zero leads attributed, suggesting tracking disconnect.
3-day lead signal (Oct 15–17: 1+5+3=9 leads) vs prior 3 days (Oct 12–14: 0+0+0=0) is a genuine pulse, but all 9 came within a single 3-day burst after 13 consecutive zero-lead days Oct 1–14.
GBP actions fell -36.17% 7d vs prior 7d; last 4 days of series show 0 GBP actions, consistent with a Windsor data-lag window rather than an organic drop.

GHL shows 769 opportunities created but only 63 won (8.2% close rate) against 140 contacts and 0 appointments; with intake owner unconfirmed since Jul 31, leads may be entering GHL but not being worked.

suggestions.text: Confirm active GHL intake owner and audit speed-to-lead routing; 769 opps vs 0 appointments signals an unmanned seat.
suggestions.monday_update: The dispatch seat vacated on 7/7 (Vivian) has never been formally replaced in GHL, and the SOW milestone confirming a new intake owner is 48 days overdue. With 769 opportunities created and 0 appointments logged in the 28-day window, leads appear to be entering the pipeline but not being actioned. Confirm with Xavier who owns GHL intake today, verify their login is active, and check after-hours automation routing. Success is confirmed when the next 10 inbound leads each have a logged activity within 15 minutes — check by 2026-10-25.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion tracking; 8 conversions show in Ads but 0 leads attributed in 28-day window — pixel likely broken client-side.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 8 conversions over 28 days while the leads dashboard shows 0 Google-attributed leads, and $992.28 was spent in the same window. This is a known client-side pixel issue pattern. Tag Manager and the thank-you page trigger should be tested in GTM Preview mode against a live form submission. Success is confirmed when a test conversion fires and appears in Google Ads within 24 hours — target resolution by 2026-10-22.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead quality for 7 more days; 9 leads in 3 days at ~$66 CPL is encouraging but too short to scale with intake unconfirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 9 leads across Oct 15–17 after 13 consecutive zero-lead days, bringing the 28-day total to 24 at a $66.26 CPL. The burst is real but a single 3-day window is insufficient to confirm a sustained shift, and the scale-up gate explicitly requires intake owner confirmation before raising budgets. Hold current Meta spend (~$20/day) and re-check on 2026-10-25; if CPL stays below $80 across a second 7-day window and intake is confirmed, a scale suggestion becomes defensible.
